name: Sunken Citadel
description: The sunken ruins of a long-lost civilization filled with ancient technology and dark magic.

features.name: Underwater Environment
features.description: This environment is underwater (see the “Moving and Fighting Underwater” rules on page 168 of the core rulebook). In addition to those rules, a creature who breathes air tracks their supply with an Air Supply Countdown. Its starting value is equal to 3 + their tier, and it ticks down when they take an action. If a PC fails an action roll or rolls with Fear, you can use a GM move to tick down their countdown an additional time. If the roll is a failure with Fear, you can tick it down twice instead. Once their countdown triggers, a PC must mark a Stress whenever they take an action underwater until they resurface.
features.prompt: Have you ever known anyone who drowned? What do you think about to keep calm and stretch your air supply?

features.name: Air Pockets
features.description: A PC can reset their their Air Supply Countdown to its starting value by locating a pocket of air with a successful Knowledge or Instinct Roll.
features.prompt: What signs or structures do you look for? What does it feel like to know this might be the last breath you take?

features.name: Lost Technology
features.description: The ruins are carved with strange magical runes and littered with lost technology. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to learn useful information about this lost civilization from any runes or devices they come across.
features.prompt: Who once called this place home? How did their technology work? Why were they ultimately destroyed and cast down into the depths?

features.name: Deepwater Denizens
features.description: Spend a Fear to summon up to two Deep Dwellers and 1d6 Cursed Merfolk who try to bind the PCs to their will. These adversaries appear at Close range of a PC, then one immediately takes the spotlight.
features.prompt: Why do these creatures stay here among the ruins? Are they unwilling or unable to resurrect this once-prosperous civilization?
